title: Finite size scaling of bitstring probability distributions for Rydberg arrays
summary: We calculate the probabilities $p_{\{n\}}$ of the measured bitstrings $\{n\}$ for the vacuum of Rydberg ladders with $N_q$ atoms. As $N_q$ increases, the $p_{\{n\}}$ decrease but become more dense in the low $p$ region raising the possibility that their smallness could be compensated by their large number. The importance of the low probability states can be estimated from the cumulative probability distribution $Σ(p_Λ,N_q)$, which is the probability to observe any state having a probability $p\leq p_Λ$.
